input: Qin et al. (2024) evaluate ToolLLaMA with ToolEval, an automatic evaluator based on ChatGPT, reporting 87.1% agreement with human annotators on pass rate and 80.3% on win rate. ChatGPT is also the teacher model that generated the ToolBench training data, and win rate is measured against ChatGPT-ReACT. Critique a claim that ToolEval scores are as reliable as human evaluation for comparing all models.
source: Qin et al. 2024, Section 3 Experiments, preliminary experiments and Table 4 (chunks qin2024-017, qin2024-018, qin2024-022)
